headline: Airtel Africa Sets N1,347.44/$ Rate for Interim Dividend
summary: Airtel Africa Plc fixed an exchange rate of N1,347.44 per dollar for its interim dividend of 3.1 US cents per share, resulting in N41.77 per share for Nigerian Exchange shareholders.
why: Airtel Africa is a major telecommunications and mobile money services provider operating across multiple African markets, listed on the London Stock Exchange and Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: Airtel Africa
impacts.why: The company announced its exchange rate setting for dividend payments to local shareholders.
